about: A tool that turns HTML pages into rendered videos, built so code and AI agents can make video.

prs.title: A block used twice in a video keeps its own timing
prs.broken: A clip can start relative to another clip by name. When one block appeared twice in a video, both copies looked that name up in the first copy, so the second copy's clips dropped out.
prs.changed: A clip now looks for the named clip inside its own composition first, as the docs say, and only then in the whole page.
prs.matters: Reusing a block several times in one video renders every copy correctly.
